record.body:
## Description

R3: The live store holds no `score:backlog-item` record.
R4: The live store holds no `score:feedback` record.
R7: `canon validate` reports no errors on the live store after the conversion.

## Approach

Parent session, primary checkout `/home/andrewyin/orchestra`, no other chat writing the store. 1) Run a throwaway script (scratchpad, not committed) that calls `apply_steps(Store(Path('.canon')), [{'rename_type': {'score:backlog-item': 'composer:idea'}}])`. 2) Commit `.canon` on `main`. 3) Run `CANON_SCHEMA_PATH=<phase worktree>/orchestra/score/schemas/score.json canon schemas sync`; confirm score reports `updated`. 4) Commit `.canon` again. 5) `canon validate`.

payload.title: Convert the live store to composer:idea
